items.title: Can smarter technology selection help de-risk small-molecule development?
items.summary: Predictive modelling for drug formulation helps developers select promising approaches and identify manufacturing challenges earlier.

items.title: OrbiMed raises $3bn to back global life science players
items.summary: The duo of funds will support companies across the biopharma, healthcare technology, diagnostics and medical device disciplines.

items.title: AstraZeneca and insitro forge $1.5bn AI-powered cardiometabolic partnership
items.summary: This insitro deal sees AstraZeneca double down on its plans to enter the MASH market, which is expected to reach a value of $20.3bn in 2032.

items.title: Acta Pharmaceuticals raises $24m for Alzheimer’s therapies
items.summary: Acta Pharmaceuticals has secured $24m in seed funding for advancing a drug pipeline focused on early intervention and prevention of AD, including the clinical progression of its lead candidate, GSM-779690T.

items.title: RevMed’s pancreatic cancer drug inches closer to EU approval after panel’s backing
items.summary: Revolution’s Rasonque has been called a turning point for pancreatic cancer patients, nearly doubling median overall survival in the second-line setting.
